eps.ov: ITEM goes after a doctor performing unethical experiments on children.
ITEM rescues a girl from the Dark May Project.
Choubi Hanano joins ITEM as they investigate an underground fighting ring.
ITEM battles a girl who can make dolls and weapons from liquid metal.
Hanano infiltrates a secure building to get the information ITEM needs.
ITEM tracks down their quarry to an empty library where a fighting tournament is held.
ITEM faces off with their counterparts in the underground colosseum.
